title: Full App Pipeline Wiring — All Dispatcher Actions to UI
description: Wire every unwired dispatcher (285 actions across 13 dispatchers) through the full pipeline: backend route → API client → TypeScript types → React hook → page component → App.tsx route. Each unit creates one complete feature page with all layers. Culminates in a fully-pipelined system ready for UI design polish.

units.title: Mechanical Design Calculator Page
units.description: Create /mechanical route with calculator page for 51 mechanical engineering engines (gears, bearings, springs, brakes, couplings, shafts, fasteners). Tab layout by category. Each tab: input form → calculate → results card.
acceptance_criteria: Route: POST /api/v1/mechanical/* (8+ endpoints covering gear, bearing, spring, shaft, fastener, coupling, brake, cam categories)
API client: mechanical.ts with typed functions per category
Types: mechanical.ts with request/response interfaces per calculation type
Hook: useMechanical.ts with exports per category
Page: MechanicalDesignPage.tsx with 8 tabs (Gears, Bearings, Springs, Shafts, Fasteners, Couplings, Brakes, Cams)

Page: MachineLivePage.tsx with tabs: Overview | Adaptive Control | Predictive Maintenance | Digital Twin
